changes.invariant: A Greenfield runtime worker is identified by workerId; Chrome windowId is only a transient attachment and may never implicitly recover another worker's queue/process state.
A fresh worker with no own queue starts empty; legacy window-keyed/orphan queues are quarantined and never auto-rebound.

Concurrent cross-worker registry writes are serialized and metadata-only; same-worker queue saves are revision-fenced so stale concurrent writers fail closed instead of silently overwriting newer state.
Named queue sets are reusable configuration templates only and cannot transport runtime ownership/state between workers.
PAUSE_PROCESS holds the current worker until its mission-level not-before wake; queue quantum expiration cannot override it. YIELD_TO_QUEUE remains distinct.
A stale queue wake alarm cannot act on a new worker that reuses the same Chrome windowId.
